 type wan

interface eth 3
 type lan
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 1
 no shutdown
 exit
!
interface eth 5
 type lan
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk native vlan 1

 no shutdown
 exit
!

 exit

 exit
!

 exit

 exit
